name: 游蛇魔使
evolution: 水滴蛇 → 水蛇锁 Lv.16 → 游蛇魔使 Lv.36
description: 真理的引路人，传闻它们最初的使命早已失败，但仍在守望，守望古老预言的验证，或是等待一段新的契约。它们拥有修长柔软的尾巴，据说尾巴尖端可以打开远古的知识之门。“真理从不主动现身——你愿意推开这扇门吗？”
descriptionEn: A guide to the truth. It is said that their original mission failed long ago, yet they still keep watch — watching for the fulfillment of an ancient prophecy, or waiting for a new covenant. They have long, supple tails, and it is said the tip of the tail can open the gate of ancient knowledge. “Truth never reveals itself on its own — will you push this door open?”

skills.description: 敌方获得双防-70%，应对防御：额外使被应对技能冷却2回合。

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 2 hits; for each successful counter, this skill's hit count permanently +2.

skills.name: 提气

skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +40 power to all skills; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, gains an additional +50 power.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for every -1 to this skill's energy cost, power +10.

skills.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to Rain for 8 turns.

skills.name: 听桥

skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 60%; when countering an attack: deals Fighting-type physical damage to the enemy with power equal to the countered skill.
